Shipped outer-driver that re-invokes /auto until deterministic stop — closes Cursor single-turn limitation documented in US-0088 / R-0071

topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: In downstream repos /auto stops after every US or bug despite scratchpad on auto; operator wants stronger automation — build software, run manual UAT steps via API or any method, auto-resolve blocks until green, and jump to the next OPEN US/bug without waiting.

Cursor IDE its-magic orchestration across installed kit repos; merged .cursor/scratchpad.md; handoffs/resume_brief.md; normative docs/engineering/auto-orchestration-reference.md; optional local/remote runtime per US-0065/US-0086.

Markdown command specs, Python stdlib scripts for outer driver and verification helpers, contract tests in tests/auto_command_contract_test.py; compose on existing US-0065 runtime QA autopilot and US-0066 generated-test scaffold.

Extend US-0088 continuous /auto and US-0044 backlog drain with opt-in full_autonomy flow mode, shipped outer-driver equivalence (not operator-only manual re-invoke), bounded retry caps, spawn-only subagents unchanged (BUG-0006 / US-0069).

Default-off opt-in via scratchpad; when enabled, silent continuation across phases and backlog items; notify only on cap exhaustion, unrecoverable error, or explicit operator-configured hard gates — orthogonal to AUTO_QUIET and TOKEN_PROFILE.

Full autonomy must not bypass secrets paths, .env, intake evidence integrity, or publish-to-production without explicit RELEASE_PUBLISH_MODE=auto; auto-remediation bounded and auditable with reason codes and attempt ledgers.

Reliability first: contract tests for outer-driver loop, drain advance without operator tick, TOKEN_PROFILE automation orthogonality audit; reuse AUTO_LOOP_MAX_CYCLES and AUTO_BACKLOG_MAX_STORIES as safety caps.

Single story US-0092 closes the gap left by US-0088 outer-driver-as-documentation-only; operator explicitly requires TOKEN_PROFILE must affect token usage only, not automation level — audit and fix any conflicting docs.
